faq.headline: Do you have any questions?
faq.subheadline: Here you will find answers to the most important questions about our offer.

questions.q: How does the free trial lesson work?
questions.a: You register, we discuss your goals and match you with a suitable teacher for a non-binding first session.

questions.q: How do you find the right teacher for me?
questions.a: We use your information on learning goals, subject, and preferred times to select the ideal teacher from our network.

questions.q: Where do the lessons take place?
questions.a: Lessons take place entirely online via a user-friendly video platform.
We currently offer German, English, Arabic, and French.
Very flexible. You arrange the appointments directly with your teacher to fit your schedule.

questions.q: Who is the offer suitable for?
questions.a: For students of all ages, university students, and adults who want to improve their language or subject skills.
